trello.name: Set Up Stripe Subscription Tiers
trello.desc: Create subscription plans for Basic, Pro, and Enterprise tiers in Stripe. Ensure each plan reflects the correct pricing and features as discussed in the meeting.

trello.name: Integrate Stripe Elements for Checkout
trello.desc: Implement Stripe Elements on the frontend for the checkout process. Ensure the form is secure, customizable, and aligns with the app’s design. Handle errors such as invalid card details gracefully.

trello.name: Update Pricing Page
trello.desc: Revise the pricing page to reflect the new subscription tiers. Include a clear comparison of features and ensure the checkout button is prominent. Add tooltips or help icons for plan changes.

trello.name: Develop User Dashboard Functionalities
trello.desc: Design a user dashboard that provides current plan details, billing info, options to upgrade/downgrade/cancel subscriptions, access to invoices, and payment history. Ensure real-time updates and notifications for changes.

trello.name: Backend Integration with Stripe API
trello.desc: Implement backend logic to create and manage subscriptions, handle payments, and integrate with Stripe’s API. Ensure the system processes payments and manages webhooks for events like payment success or failure.

trello.name: Webhook Event Management
trello.desc: Set up webhook handlers for events such as invoice.payment_succeeded, invoice.payment_failed, and customer.subscription.deleted. Ensure the system updates correctly and users receive notifications as needed.

trello.name: Testing Plan for Subscription Flow
trello.desc: Create a detailed test plan covering manual and automated tests. Test the entire subscription flow, including sign-up, billing, and subscription management. Simulate scenarios like payment failures and cancellations.

trello.name: User Documentation and Support
trello.desc: Prepare user documentation and support materials, including a help section or FAQ. Provide clear instructions on managing subscriptions, accessing invoices, and troubleshooting common issues.
